changelog.body:
First release in the LSPosed Modules Repository.

- iOS 26-style liquid glass tab bar for Instagram: real blur, refracting lens, springy draggable pill, shrink on scroll and a glass side rail on tablets.
- Settings app with a live preview, in Miuix or Material 3 Expressive.
- New package name: `io.github.maciasdav.instaglass`.

# InstaGlass ### iOS 26 liquid glass, inside Instagram
[![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/maciasdav/InstaGlass?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=0d1117)](https://github.com/maciasdav/InstaGlass/releases) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/maciasdav/InstaGlass?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=0d1117)](https://github.com/maciasdav/InstaGlass/blob/main/LICENSE) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/maciasdav/InstaGlass/total?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=0d1117&cacheSeconds=3600)](https://github.com/maciasdav/InstaGlass/releases)
[**Download**](#download) · [**Features**](#features) · [**Setup**](#setup) · [**Credits**](#credits) · [**Disclaimer**](#disclaimer)
> [!IMPORTANT] > InstaGlass is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Instagram or Meta in any way. It needs root and LSPosed (or Vector). Use it at your own discretion. ---

Features

#### The glass - **Floating bar** — your feed scrolls under a capsule of real glass. - **A lens that bends light** at the edges, just like iOS 26. - **Glass over videos and Reels**, not only photos. - **Shrinks while you scroll**, comes back when you scroll up. - **Side rail on tablets**, with its own glass capsule. #### The pill - **Slides between tabs** with spring physics. - **Drag it** with your finger to switch tabs. - **Never freezes**, even when Instagram is busy loading a tab. #### The app - **Tune everything live** — blur, tint, lens, size, pill and more, with a live preview. - **Two styles** — HyperOS (Miuix) or Material 3 Expressive. - **Make it yours** — light, dark or AMOLED, wallpaper colors or your own color. - **One tap to restart Instagram** and apply changes. #### Safe by design - **Only visual** — it never touches your account, your data or the network. - **If something breaks, it steps aside** — Instagram keeps working.
---

Download

Grab the latest APK from the [**Releases**](https://github.com/maciasdav/InstaGlass/releases) page.
---

Setup

1. Install the APK. 2. In **LSPosed** or **Vector**, enable **InstaGlass** and tick **Instagram**. 3. Open **InstaGlass** and tap **Restart Instagram**. That's it. You'll need **Android 13 or newer**, **root**, and **LSPosed** or **Vector**. ---

Credits

Preview photos by [**@mha.mahamek**](https://www.instagram.com/mha.mahamek). [Miuix](https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix) · [KernelSU](https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU) · [LSPosed](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPosed) · [Kyant0/backdrop](https://github.com/Kyant0/backdrop) Made by [**David Macias**](https://github.com/maciasdav).
---

Disclaimer

InstaGlass is an independent, personal project. It is **not** associated with Instagram, Meta, or any of their parent companies.
---

License

**MIT**. See [LICENSE](https://github.com/maciasdav/InstaGlass/blob/main/LICENSE). The glass shaders come from [Kyant0/backdrop](https://github.com/Kyant0/backdrop) (Apache 2.0) and the preview photos belong to @mha.mahamek — see [NOTICE](https://github.com/maciasdav/InstaGlass/blob/main/NOTICE).

<表> #### 玻璃 - **浮动栏** — 您的提要在真正的玻璃胶囊下滚动。 - **边缘会弯曲光线的镜头**，就像 iOS 26 一样。 - **视频和卷轴上的玻璃**，而不仅仅是照片。 - **滚动时缩小**，向上滚动时返回。 - **平板电脑上的侧轨**，带有自己的玻璃胶囊。 #### 药丸 - **利用弹簧物理原理在选项卡之间滑动**。 - **用手指拖动**来切换选项卡。 - **永远不会冻结**，即使 Instagram 正忙于加载标签。 #### 该应用程序 - **实时调整一切** — 模糊、色调、镜头、尺寸、药片等，并可实时预览。 - **两种风格** — HyperOS (Miuix) 或 Material 3 Expressive。 - **让它成为你的** - 浅色、深色或 AMOLED、壁纸颜色或你自己的颜色。 - **一键重启 Instagram** 并应用更改。 #### 设计安全 - **仅视觉** - 它永远不会触及您的帐户、您的数据或网络。 - **如果出现问题，它会退到一边** — Instagram 继续运行。 ---

下载

从 [**Releases**](https://github.com/maciasdav/InstaGlass/releases) 页面获取最新的 APK。 ---

1.安装APK。 2. 在 **LSPosed** 或​​ **Vector** 中，启用 **InstaGlass** 并勾选 **Instagram**。 3. 打开 **InstaGlass** 并点击 **重新启动 Instagram**。 就是这样。您需要 **Android 13 或更高版本**、**root** 和 **LSPosed** 或​​ **Vector**。 ---
